FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT
GUEST FACULTY REQUIRED IN ICSVS
No. of Position:1
Interview to be held on 21.08.2025 at 02:30 pm. ICSVS for the appointment of Guest
Faculty to teach certificate courses at the Interdisciplinary Centre for Swami
Vivekananda Studies, (ICSVS) Panjab University Chandigarh for the Session (June-
December)2025-26.
Name of Post: (1) Assistant Professor
Essentials: M.A in Yoga/ M.Sc in Yogic Sciences with a
minimum of 55 % Marks from a recognised
University established under UGC Act.
Desirable: UGC NET/JRF in the relevant Subject and
Certificate Course in Swami Vivekananda
Studies
Last Date for Application Submission: 20.08.2025 till 1.00 p.m.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificate and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the following details at
the time of interview:
1. Name
2. Date of birth
3. Educational Qualification (with percentage from 10th onward Attached
self- attested Photocopies)
4. Attested photocopy of Degree M.A./ Ph.D.
5. Teaching Experience (attach details)
6. Any other relevant documents like Projects completed (self-attested)
7. Publications etc.
8. Correspondence Address
9. Contact No./ Mobile No.
10. E-mail ID
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
(Prof. Shivani Sharma)
Coordinator, ICSVS
